top_signals.title: UK Borrowing Exceeds Forecast in Final Data Before Budget
top_signals.summary: Britain borrowed more than forecast in the first six months of the fiscal year, highlighting the constraints facing Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey ahead of his inaugural budget next week.

top_signals.title: Japan demands access to journalist detained in Russia as spy row persists
top_signals.summary: A senior Japanese official met with his Russian counterpart, urging the "immediate release" of a Hokkaido Shimbun reporter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UK debt pile exceeds £3 trillion one week before Healey’s Budget
top_signals.summary: The size of the UK public debt skimmed £3 trillion in September in official data released one week before John Healey’s Budget.  The major milestone reflects the difficulties facing the Chancellor ahead of his maiden fiscal statement. Public sector debt rapidly climbed over the pas six years, exceeding £2 trillion in June 2020.
